steps.mirror: In contrary motion the hands move in opposite directions, like a mirror. Both thumbs start: the right thumb on middle {c}, the left thumb on the {c} an octave below. The right hand goes up while the left hand goes down, with the same finger numbers at the same time.
steps.outward: Move outwards: both hands play fingers 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 together.
steps.inward: And back in, from 5 to 1, until the thumbs are back on their first keys.
steps.inTime: Out and back in, in time with the metronome: the same finger in both hands on every click.
